segments.text: [cheerful] Beep beep! Here comes the *Rainbow Bus*! Little Milo is driving on a sunny day. Hop on, hop on, come ride with us!
[excited] First stop, the *red* stop! Bella Bunny has a big red balloon! Bounce, bounce, bounce, up she goes! Red, red, red, hello, hello!
[playfully] Next stop, the *yellow* stop! Duckie is splashing in the puddle! Quack, quack, quack, hop on with me! Yellow, yellow, yellow, happy as can be!
[cheerful] Then the *green* stop, up the hill! Froggy Fred is waving! Ribbit, ribbit, jump, jump, jump! Green, green, green, the wheels go bump, bump, bump!
[warm] Now the *blue* stop, by the sea. Little Bear has a bucket full of shells! Splash, splash, splash! Blue, blue, blue, come sit by me!
[excited] Let's count our friends! One Milo, two Bella, three Duckie, four Fred, five Little Bear! Five happy friends on the *Rainbow Bus*!
[amazed] Look up high, a *rainbow*! Red and yellow, green and blue, shining just for you!
[gentle] The sun is going down, down, down. Wave goodbye, goodbye, goodbye! Beep beep, *goodnight*!
